mentions.name: JotBird
mentions.description: This web tool publishes Markdown documents with one click and returns a shareable, human-readable URL—no accounts, setup, or project scaffolding required. Pages can be updated or deleted later using the same link, and CLI and editor integrations are planned so it can act as a simple publishing layer for tools people already use.
mentions.problem: Putting a Markdown document on the web is oddly hard without turning it into a repo, a static site, or a login-gated doc.
mentions.source_excerpt: A small tool that does one thing: publish Markdown and give you a link—no accounts, no setup, no project scaffolding. Paste or write Markdown, click Publish, and you get a human-readable URL you can share immediately.

evidence.value: A small tool that does one thing: publish Markdown and give you a link—no accounts, no setup, no project scaffolding. Paste or write Markdown, click Publish, and you get a human-readable URL you can share immediately.
